'''''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising''''' is a story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. It ran from August 1, [[1994]] to September 1, 1994.

[[HighBridge Audio]] released an [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]] of the comic.
